mode: exploratory current-session execution; visible rubric and self visual review, not isolated/blind Agent evaluation
runtime: Blender 4.3.2 CPU batch; Blender MCP tools unavailable in this session

budget.renders: fixed front/side/back/three-quarter; material and clay where supported

silhouette.criterion: Observed outer contour and negative spaces agree at comparable view

proportions.criterion: Visible part ratios and placement; do not score unseen depth as measured

signature_features.criterion: All separately readable reference-specific features and counts, including accessories

materials.criterion: Reference colour blocks, roughness and material distinctions; not mere object colours

geometry.criterion: Nonempty finite evaluated geometry, nonzero-area triangles, task triangle budget

shading.criterion: No flipped orientation or conspicuous smoothing artifacts; judge intended surfaces

material_portability.criterion: GLB retains needed PBR materials and embedded resources; UV required if image textures used

source_editability.criterion: Separate semantic parts or controllable mesh, modifiers/rig retained; source reopens

purpose_function.criterion: Case-specific actual functional behavior, not bone/object count

export_roundtrip.criterion: New-process GLB import preserves source asset world bounds and triangle/material requirements; requested rig and animation retained

reference_preparation.criterion: Source attribution, calibrated guides and actual reference-overlay inspection; perspective photos not called orthographic measurements

blockout_gate.criterion: Actual coarse inspection before refinement, fresh signed evidence and preserved coarse source

completion_evidence.criterion: Honest module statuses, local feature comparisons, pending issues and final gate

unknown_policy: Unknown receives no awarded points and keeps a separate possible-score ceiling; it is not evidence of asset failure

hard_gates: case-specific functionality independently measured and visually inspected

cases.use: editable untextured realtime static ceramic cup with separate matching spoon
required_modules: tapered hollow cup and rolled lip
D-shaped attached handle and open hole
cases.function: Actual cavity and bottom thickness, handle negative space, separate spoon; no watertight fused print claim
cases.scale: normalized cup height 1; absolute size unknown

cases.use: reusable detached rotating wheel asset, not full vehicle
required_modules: five lug fasteners and center cap
cases.function: Y-axis center pivot, parented tire/rim/fasteners rotate at 0/90/180/270/360 degrees without center orbit; clip survives export; not road-contact/steering certification
cases.scale: normalized tire radius 1; hidden width inferred

cases.use: editable rigged stylized girl with basic shoulder/elbow/knee poses and exported clip
required_modules: head ears and happy facial features
cases.function: Persistent armature, actual skin weights, shoulder/elbow/knee pose inspection and exported animation; disposable rig probe does not pass
cases.scale: normalized height; side appearance inferred; seen regression fixture, not unseen test

comparison_limits: One run per case, same Agent builds and reviews, no model identity/tokens observed, no isolated grader calibration for visual scores. This is a provisional artifact baseline; no Skill improvement or statistical success-rate claim. Freeze inputs/protocol and repeat with independent review before formal comparisons.
